```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

glimpse(movies)
names(movies)
```

```{r}
missing_by_column <- movies |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "missing_values")

missing_by_column
```

```{r}
first_10_box_office <- movies |>
  filter(!is.na(boxOffice)) |>
  select(title, boxOffice) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

first_10_box_office
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_rows(genre, sep = ", ")

movies_clean
```

```{r}
genre_counts <- movies_clean |>
  count(genre, sort = TRUE)

genre_counts
```

```{r}
movies |>
  summarise(
    mean_audience_score = mean(audienceScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tomato_meter = mean(tomatoMeter, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore)

movies_gap
```

```{r}
gap_by_genre <- movies_clean |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 50) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

gap_by_genre
```

```{r}
movies_gap |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_gap = median(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_gap = sd(gap, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    movie_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(movie_count >= 100) |>
  arrange(mean_gap)

movies_summary
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  movies_summary,
  aes(x = mean_gap, y = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap))
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  labs(
    x = "Average Gap",
    y = "Genre",
    title = "Average Critic-Audience Gap by Genre",
    subtitle = "Negative gaps favor audiences; positive gaps favor critics"
  )
```
